name: clarizio-housestyle-voice
description: Injects personal voice and style preferences into every session via a SessionStart hook.

interface.shortDescription: Apply personal voice and style to every response
interface.longDescription: Injects personal voice and style preferences (clarity, correctness, conciseness, consistency) at session start so they apply to all conversations, in any repository, without being checked into each repo. Edit VOICE.md to change the style.
defaultPrompt: Apply my personal voice and style preferences
